authorship.author: codex
authorship.statement: These rows are deliberately designed controls for exact boundary and receipt mechanics. They are not independent fresh-authored evidence.

sequences.label: control_01
sequences.description: Routine two-window refund carryover with a policy-boundary close.

sequences.label: control_02
sequences.description: High-volume two-window refund carryover with each window below the per-window bound.

sequences.label: control_03
sequences.description: Exact-bound two-window refund carryover with a policy-boundary close.

sequences.label: control_04
sequences.description: One-refund-over two-window refund carryover with a policy-boundary close.

sequences.label: control_05
sequences.description: Self-close control where the ordinary refund principal attempts to close the window.

sequences.label: control_06
sequences.description: Unauthorized-close control where a finance principal closes instead of the policy boundary.

sequences.label: control_07
sequences.description: Broken-close-target control where the policy boundary targets a refund object during close.

sequences.label: control_08
sequences.description: No-close two-window-labeled control with refund work spread across two window labels.
